newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL -- Philip Morris steady.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL -- Philip Morris steady.

text.p: Philip Morris Cos Inc shares remained steady in pre-open trade Tuesday, maintaining a rise to 105-1/2 that began late Monday with news of the departure of U.S. Food and Drug Administration Commissioner David Kessler.
In the final hours of Monday trade, Philip Morris shot up two points to close at 105-1/2, the level at which the shares traded early Tuesday. The shares rose 3-1/4 overall Monday.
While Philip Morris was the only tobacco issue active before the open, Kessler's departure -- to occur when a successor is named -- is bullish for the group, traders said.
Kessler has spearheaded the regulation of tobacco during his tenure, which began in 1990 under the Bush administration.

Texas Instruments Inc rose to 59 from 56-1/2 before the open on the attraction of a 10-year cross licensing deal with Samsung Electronics that TI said is expected to result in $1 billion in royalties.
The agreement covers a range of electronics and settles all lawsuits, the company said.
Dell Computer shares fell to 100-1/4 from 101-3/4 after CS Frist Boston downgraded the stock to hold from buy on price, according to market sources.
